name: AeroAssist
tagline: Explains why your flight is delayed in plain language and offers rebooking and compensation options.
problem: Delayed passengers get vague jargon and little guidance.
solution: Translates operational delay data into human explanations, calms anxiety and proposes options by delay severity.
demo_moment: Team-described: a long delay triggers compensation options.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[MLH] Best Use of Auth0” among 176 submissions.

lessons: Explain the why; uncertainty is what passengers hate.
